title: WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.30134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized large language models (LLMs) should continually adapt to users' evolving preferences. Yet extracting preference changes from noisy interaction histories while supporting inexpensive updates remains challenging. We introduce WASP (Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization), a recurrent framework that captures fine-grained preferences directly from raw user interactions and generates personalized LoRA adapters without expensive per-user optimization. Specifically, WASP achieves this by training a shared hypernetwork that maintains a compact user representation and outputs adapter weights in a single forward pass. As new interactions arrive, WASP updates this representation without reprocessing full interaction history, enabling continual adaptation with per-update costs independent of history length. translated_title: WASP：面向流式LLM个性化的持续权重自适应
translated_abstract: 个性化大语言模型（LLM）应当持续适应用户不断变化的偏好。然而，如何从嘈杂的交互历史中提取偏好变化，同时支持低成本的更新，仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了WASP（面向流式个性化的权重自适应），这是一个循环框架，能够直接从原始用户交互中捕获细粒度偏好，并生成个性化的LoRA适配器，而无需昂贵的逐用户优化。具体而言，WASP通过训练一个共享超网络来实现这一目标，该超网络维护一个紧凑的用户表示，并在单次前向传播中输出适配器权重。当新交互到来时，WASP无需重新处理完整的交互历史即可更新该表示，从而实现持续自适应，且每次更新的成本与历史长度无关。在个性化基准测试和按时间顺序排列的交互流上的实验表明，WASP能够持续保持高质量的个性化效果。
tldr: WASP是一个循环框架，通过共享超网络直接从原始用户交互中生成个性化LoRA适配器，使LLM个性化能够持续适应新交互，且每次更新成本与历史长度无关。
en_tdlr: WASP is a recurrent framework that generates personalized LoRA adapters directly from raw user interactions via a shared hypernetwork, enabling continual LLM personalization with per-update costs independent of history length.
